permitted_use: Use f/v split as a derived orthographic modeling operation.
Use 27 x 8 = 216 only when the split operation is explicitly labeled.
Use split forms in design, teaching, and computational normalization only with layer metadata.
forbidden_use: Do not describe 27 rows as source-observed.
Do not describe 216 cells as the primary source inventory.
Do not use the split as evidence of completed phonological or glyph-level review.
article_implication: Article 3 can argue that the f/v row is the controlled hinge between source and derived systems; it cannot claim a completed phonological review, public glyph corpus, or encoding proposal.
